title: DOMSnapshot
description: Sanitized DOM accessibility-tree snapshot sent from the extension (Dev2 extractor, post Dev3 privacy pass) to the server planner (Dev5).

elements.description: Tagged, interactive elements from the accessibility tree.

id.description: Stable numeric tag assigned by the extractor; referenced by action.schema.json to target this element.

tag.description: Uppercase HTML tag name, e.g. INPUT, BUTTON, A.

type.description: Input type attribute, if applicable (e.g. search, password, submit).

role.description: ARIA role or inferred role, e.g. searchbox, button, link.

text.description: Visible text content, if any (post-sanitization by Dev3's privacy worker).

rect.description: [x, y, width, height] bounding box in viewport coordinates.

forms.description: Detected forms on the page, with vault availability per field (no actual values).

context_sufficient.description: Set by the extractor: whether the DOM alone gives enough context for the current screen, or whether the vision worker should also be invoked. Optional in Phase 1; required once the vision-gating flow lands.
